title: ForgetBench: Benchmarking Forgetting Dynamics of Long-Term Parametric Memory in Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2607.26455v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in knowledge acquisition and reasoning, yet their ability to retain previously acquired knowledge under repeated updates remains insufficiently understood. Existing evaluation paradigms primarily focus on single-step reasoning or static knowledge editing, which fail to capture the temporal dynamics of knowledge retention and degradation during continual model modification. In this work, we propose \textbf{ForgetBench}, a benchmark for measuring forgetting dynamics in the long-term parametric memory of LLMs under continual knowledge editing. ForgetBench introduces two complementary evaluation paradigms, namely concept-based QA and scenario-based QA, to probe the retention of isolated facts and structured relational knowledge. translated_title: ForgetBench：语言模型长期参数记忆遗忘动态基准测试
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）在知识获取和推理方面展现出强大的能力，但其在反复更新过程中保留先前所学知识的能力仍缺乏充分理解。现有评估范式主要聚焦于单步推理或静态知识编辑，无法捕捉模型持续修改过程中知识保留与退化的时间动态特性。在本工作中，我们提出了ForgetBench，这是一个用于测量LLMs在持续知识编辑下长期参数记忆遗忘动态的基准。ForgetBench引入了两种互补的评估范式，即基于概念的问答和基于场景的问答，以探测孤立事实和结构化关系知识的保留情况。基于序列编辑框架，我们构建了按时间排序的知识流，并在多个维度上评估模型行为。
tldr: 该论文提出ForgetBench，一个通过基于概念和基于场景的两种互补问答范式，评估大语言模型在持续知识编辑下长期参数记忆遗忘动态的基准测试。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes ForgetBench, a benchmark for measuring the forgetting dynamics of long-term parametric memory in LLMs under continual knowledge editing, using complementary concept-based and scenario-based QA paradigms to probe the retention of isolated facts and structured relational knowledge.
